gain_denominator: Frozen C1 B2, paired by panel, patient and seed; graph-vs-MEAN also paired by panel/patient/seed, each method using its own validation-selected graph.

gene_support_rule.interpretation: Descriptive prioritization, not a significance test or proof of independent replication. Conditional folds overlap and reuse frozen panels.

reporting: Report all genes, not only shortlisted genes, including negative gains and disagreement between correlation and error. No selection from primary test metrics or retrospective graph search.
